attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post, not a quotation of anyone else.

semantics.note: 'Will almost-certainly' signals high confidence about a definite outcome, so it is a scored forecast. The hedged size clause ('likely at a similar scale') is correctly left out. The stated reason (IPO likely delayed) is kept as a qualifier. The horizon 'by March 2027' is preserved.

contract.note: Reading 'by March 2027' as on or before 2027-03-31 is reasonable. Treating 'have to raise' as a forecast of need, not of a closed round, is generous to the speaker but fair. Showing need relies on company disclosures, which the contract labels as such. Nothing turns on interpretation yet because the forecast is not due.

output.rationale: This is a high-confidence forecast with a deadline of 2027-03-31, which is after the 2026-10-28 evaluation date. There is no early-resolution rule. The packet contains no evidence items; the only source considered is an unused secondary report of talks. Under policy the forecast cannot be scored before its deadline, so it is unresolved and not due.
